answer: Farming becomes a cedar bet on surviving 53 epochs of grading, and every oasis settlement recomputes the raven schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 53 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 11 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
